content:
# New Client Onboarding Workflow
# Engine-agnostic reference document. Not executable by any specific tool;
# intended as the source of truth for the onboarding process.

workflow:
  name: new_client_onboarding
  description: >
    Standard sequential onboarding for new clients. Begins when Sales hands
    off a closed deal and ends when the client is fully handed off to the
    delivery team.
  version: 1.0.0
  flow_type: sequential

trigger:
  event: sales_handoff
  description: Sales team marks a deal as closed-won and hands it off to onboarding.
  inputs:
    - client_name
    - signed_deal_record
    - sales_notes

steps:
  - id: handoff_intake
    name: Sales Handoff Intake
    owner: onboarding_lead
    depends_on: []
    description: Receive the closed deal from Sales and confirm completeness.
    inputs:
      - signed_deal_record
      - sales_notes
    outputs:
      - onboarding_case_opened
    completion_criteria: >
      Onboarding case exists, deal record is complete, and an onboarding lead
      is assigned.

  - id: collect_client_info
    name: Collect Client Information
    owner: onboarding_lead
    depends_on: [handoff_intake]
    description: Gather client details (company profile, contacts, requirements).
    inputs:
      - client_name
      - onboarding_case_opened
    outputs:
      - client_profile
      - stakeholder_contact_list
      - requirements_summary
    completion_criteria: >
      Client profile and at least one primary stakeholder contact are recorded,
      and requirements are summarized and acknowledged by the client.

  - id: finalize_agreement
    name: Finalize Agreement / Contract
    owner: account_manager
    depends_on: [collect_client_info]
    description: Send the service agreement and track it to full signature.
    inputs:
      - client_profile
      - requirements_summary
    outputs:
      - signed_service_agreement
    completion_criteria: >
      Fully executed service agreement is stored and linked to the onboarding
      case.

  - id: provision_access
    name: Provision Accounts & Access
    owner: it_admin
    depends_on: [finalize_agreement]
    description: Create client accounts, credentials, and system access.
    inputs:
      - stakeholder_contact_list
      - signed_service_agreement
    outputs:
      - provisioned_accounts
      - access_grants
    completion_criteria: >
      All listed stakeholders have accounts and the access levels defined in
      the agreement; credentials delivered via secure channel.

  - id: kickoff_meeting
    name: Kickoff Meeting
    owner: onboarding_lead
    depends_on: [provision_access]
    description: Coordinate the intro meeting with client stakeholders.
    inputs:
      - client_profile
      - requirements_summary
      - provisioned_accounts
    outputs:
      - kickoff_minutes
      - agreed_timeline
    completion_criteria: >
      Kickoff held with client stakeholders; minutes and an agreed timeline
      are recorded.

  - id: delivery_handoff
    name: Handoff to Delivery Team
    owner: onboarding_lead
    depends_on: [kickoff_meeting]
    description: Transfer onboarding docs to delivery and assign owners.
    inputs:
      - kickoff_minutes
      - agreed_timeline
      - requirements_summary
      - signed_service_agreement
    outputs:
      - delivery_case_accepted
    completion_criteria: >
      Delivery team accepts the handoff with named owners; onboarding case is
      closed.

completion:
  condition: delivery_case_accepted exists
  description: Onboarding is complete when the delivery team has accepted the handoff.
